evidence.reason: The claim is a conditional hardening proposal, not a demonstrated defect: it holds only "if the pinned tree contains" two same-named templates. render_units (current lines 681-684) enumerates apps/crq-python/ops/systemd/ and filters by basename; no supplied evidence shows a duplicate basename or a subdirectory under systemd/ that would make the flattening at lines 706-709 collide. Unique basenames render normally, and nothing in the current contract requires a duplicate-basename rejection or any new validation of the template inventory. Adding such a check would enlarge protection scope rather than repair an observed error in intended behavior.
